history.name: Each feature as a row of the ledger
history.description: The body reads as a ledger: every feature is a ruled row carrying its size chip, its name, and its description set to a fixed comfortable measure, under a numbered area heading that says how many features that area holds and how many of them moved. The regularity is the point — the document is scanned as much as it is read.
history.dev_notes: LedgerHtml#featureRow(), shared by the first row of a section and every row after it so the two can't drift; --measure is one shared ~70-character text width.
